title: Stream direct CSR matmul rows instead of materializing the full right block
finding: TypedRelationBlock.matmul eagerly copied every row of the right CSR block into a Python list of tuples before beginning multiplication. Direct bounded calls therefore touched and duplicated unrelated right rows even when the left block never referenced them, and an over-budget call could allocate that copy before the operation guard fired.
primary_claim: The reference matmul now reads the canonical right CSR arrays only for middle-axis rows actually referenced by left entries. It preserves exact semiring composition and the existing operation limit while removing the eager right_rows materialization.
gardener_decision: Delete the transient right_rows copy and traverse the already-canonical CSR row slices in place. Do not add a cache, sparse backend, planner, alternate block type, or cost-model abstraction.
acceptance: direct matmul does not access an unreferenced right CSR row
direct matmul still refuses when max_operations is exceeded
exact inclusive-budget Boolean composition remains unchanged
Fourfold subject, semiring, and exact typed middle-axis compatibility checks remain unchanged
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created
